meta.title: Haec Diva
meta.author: Darth Shader, Ferris, Wobble
meta.description: The soundtrack of Haec Diva by Darth Shader, Ferris, Wobble (2019-04-21). 32K executable music that placed 2nd in the executable music competition at Revision 2019. 96 BPM, 3:10, 39 tracks, 2193 notes. Instruments: 13 Falcon (FM synth), 11 Slaughter (subtractive synth), 6 Adultery (GM.DLS sampler), 4 Specimen (GSM sampler). Effects: 35 Scissor, 58 Leveller, 14 Echo, 17 Smasher, 2 Chamber, 12 Twister, 24 Cathedral. Its Adultery instruments play waves from the Windows GM.DLS bank: they sound as intended only with that bank (GM_DLS=<path to gm.dls>); macOS's own GS bank has other waves. This is an adapted version, not the original recording: the WaveSabre song was read from the running executable's memory (tools/ws-extract, Wine), converted by `synth-convert ws` to the unified synth (instrument kind 64, effects 65-73) and imported with `song import` (lanes cut into 2-, 4- or 8-bar patterns, notes rounded to 960 ticks per beat). Against the bit-exact WaveSabre port it differs by +0.00 dB loudness and at most 0.09 dB in any octave band from 63 Hz to 8 kHz (16 kHz up to 3 dB brighter, a known difference of the unified engine). Track names are derived here from each track's instrument and notes; the executable does not store the authors' names. No licence is stated: the music belongs to its authors. It is published here as an adapted reference copy while its authors are asked for permission, and is removed at any author's request.
